title.zh: 费用（私人保安犬只训导员测试）命令 2018
title.en: Fees (Testing of Private Security Dog Handlers) Order 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Fees (Testing of Private Security Dog Handlers) Order 2018.
2. The fees specified in the second column of the Schedule are payable to the Commissioner of Police in respect of the matters specified opposite in the first column.
3. The Fees (Testing of Security Guard Dog Handlers) Order (O 32) is revoked.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Fees for testing of private security
dog handlers by police K-9 unit
First column
Second column
1.For the testing of the private security guard dog handler for a guard dog
$95
2.For the testing of the private security explosive detector dog handler for an explosive detector dog
$120
